patterns.name: controlled disclosure
patterns.description: A component-owned boolean can progressively disclose existing review content without changing the existing request lifecycle.

patterns.name: progressive disclosure
patterns.description: Use the established MUI button/collapse or Accordion primitives with explicit accessible state to keep the default review compact.

recommendations.subject: Existing useCompileReview state lifecycle
recommendations.rationale: It centralizes current polling, confirm, recompile, conflict, and in-flight behavior; the change is presentation-only.

recommendations.subject: MUI Button plus Collapse or Accordion
recommendations.rationale: It is already in use in StepReviewList and supports discoverable progressive disclosure without a new dependency.

recommendations.subject: Client parsing of authored English
recommendations.rationale: The codebase explicitly reserves translation truth for the server candidate artifact.

researchNotes: No external service or new package is required. Existing BRD requirements require readable validated action summaries and explicit confirmation; the design should compact their presentation rather than remove them.
